coverImageAlt: Navy truss bridge carries three hanging cyan test weights beside an unmarked brass caliper and blank block.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Requirements testing represented by a small engineered bridge undergoing a careful physical load test while precision instruments compare the structure against a clean reference form, conveying the conversion of requirements into verifiable scenarios and evidence.
Scene/backdrop: An uncluttered warm-paper laboratory table with a deep slate backdrop.
Subject: One compact navy bridge spanning two stone supports, three smooth cyan test weights suspended at distinct points, and a large brass-and-cyan caliper aligned with a separate blank reference block; one orange indicator bead marks a discovered gap.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one strong crop-safe bridge-and-caliper silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: rigorous, measured, constructive; crisp analytical side light
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: instruments and weights contain no scale marks, labels, letters, numbers, or warning symbols; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes

Targeted correction after inspection: Regenerate the same bridge load-test concept, but make every surface completely unmarked. Remove the ruler ticks from the caliper and remove all drafting lines from the paper. Place the entire caliper safely inside the frame with generous warm-paper clearance beyond it, keeping every essential object outside the outer 8% margin. Preserve the three smooth weights, bridge, separate blank reference block, palette, and tactile editorial style.
